acme_admin_jt: Hey Redwood support — after last night's SCIM sync some employees got assigned 'org_admin' in our tenant. Also our audit logs show a gap for SAML session events between 2026-03-01T22:00Z and 2026-03-02T02:00Z. We're blocked from proving least-privilege for an upcoming audit. Can someone triage? Case: ACME-8742
support_jamie: Sorry to hear that. Can you confirm whether this was SCIM push or manual via Console? Also can you paste the SCIM delta job id (we log it in /scim/jobs)?
acme_admin_jt: It was a push from Okta, job id 2026-03-02-01-17-999. We rolled out a mapping change yesterday to include 'department' → team. No manual console edits.
infra_bot: [automated] Alert: SCIM_JOB_FAILED?job=2026-03-02-01-17-999 status=200 warnings=2 logs=/logs/scim/2026/03/02-01-17-999.log :bell:
support_jamie: Can you share the first 20 lines of that log (mask PII)? Also need the list of users who got elevated roles (a short sample is fine).
acme_admin_jt: Sample: user: j.smith@example.com previous_role: user new_role: org_admin via group: SRE-Owners
sec_ana: Noted. Two immediate asks: 1) produce an audit log export for the SAML and SCIM subsystems covering that window. SAML session events are in audit.v2.events where event_type in ('saml.login','saml.logout'). SCIM sync operations are under scim.provisioning. 2) list any KMS key policy changes around 2026-03-02 — we need to ensure no key rotations or added principals that could explain decrypted payloads.
eng_kun: Looking at provisioning, common root cause is a mapping collision where Okta group has attribute that matches an internal role alias. Quick check you can run (console API):
```
GET /api/v1/tenants/{tid}/scim/jobs/2026-03-02-01-17-999/log
GET /api/v1/tenants/{tid}/roles?filter=assigned_via:scim
```
Share the output (redact user ids) and I'll correlate.
acme_admin_jt: Pasted the log to https://redwood-secure-s3/acme-8742/scim-999.log — snippet: "mapped attribute 'role_alias' -> 'org_admin' when group.displayName='SRE-Owners'". Also attached role export: 12 users assigned via scim — 4 unexpectedly elevated.
cs_maria: For immediate mitigation, create a scoped temporary deny for the 'org_admin' role and follow least-privilege rollback: remove scim mapping for role_alias, then run a dry-run sync. I can help coordinate rollback windows with your change window.
support_jamie: For the audit gaps: our ingestion pipeline rotated the audit shard at 2026-03-02T02:00Z and we had a delayed consumer restart (fixed at 02:18Z). That explains missing events — working on backfill. sec_ana, do we have KMS access logs for 01:50-02:30Z?
sec_ana: Requesting KMS CloudHSM audit: please export key_usage.log for CMK id: cmk-0a1b2c3d around that window and upload to the case bucket. Also we need to see console_admin actions: who modified role policies (api:UpdateRolePolicy).
eng_kun: I can correlate role changes. If SCIM erroneously mapped group -> role_alias, we should add a protective validation on mapping creation. I'll open a small PR and backfill a rule in the provisioning pipeline.
acme_admin_jt: One more data point — billing spike coincided with the same window, ~20% more token usage. Could be automated job creating requests under the elevated role.
support_jamie: Noted. I'll create a temporary API key revoke for any keys created between 2026-03-02T00:00-03:00Z and require reissue after audit.
infra_bot: [automated] Case ACME-8742 updated by support_jamie — mitigation actions scheduled.
sec_ana: Next steps: acme_admin_jt please upload the scim log excerpt and the role export to the case bucket, grant sec_ana read access; we will: 1) validate mapping collision 2) backfill audit events from raw workers 3) export KMS usage 4) recommend least-privilege rollback + role quarantine. ETA 24-48hrs. :lock:
acme_admin_jt: Uploaded logs and granted access. Thanks all, will stand by for backfill. Appreciate the quick coordination :pray:
support_jamie: Following up — we'll post interim status updates in this thread and escalate to infra and SRE if backfill fails.
